root_scopes.api.ComputeSampledKernels: The complete sampled-kernel API call, including its local cleanup before return.
root_scopes.frontend.model_sampling_configuration_an: Read the model, resolve the frequency grid, construct source/receiver and angular/radial sample inputs. Timed separately in the copied audit frontend.
root_scopes.frontend.sampled_kernel_csv_export: Serialize actual returned sampled-kernel arrays to the existing kernels.csv schema. Timed separately from numerical work.

counters.frequency_bins_active: Frequency indices with any nonzero measurement adjoint spectrum.
counters.degree_frequency_pairs: Active degree-frequency pairs with a response solve.
counters.rk_attempted_steps: Accepted fixed steps plus adaptive trial steps.
counters.rk_rhs_evaluations: Calls of the Runge-Kutta right-hand-side callback, including batched b-vector callbacks.
counters.rk_scalar_equation_rhs_evaluations: Callback evaluations times the number of complex state components integrated.
counters.radial_material_complexification_samples: RHS callback count; each radial or b-vector callback materializes its frequency-dependent layer material once.
counters.radial_sample_nodes: Node solves across active degree-frequency pairs.
counters.receiver_unit_rhs_directions: Independent unit receiver force directions represented by the measurement basis.
counters.angular_degree_order_component_macs: Complex coefficient times real generalized-Legendre multiply-accumulate terms in forward and adjoint angular evaluations.
counters.angular_table_degree_extent_sum: Sum of lmax+1 over constructed forward and receiver generalized-Legendre tables.
counters.angular_phase_timer_reads: Raw steady-clock reads inside the original fused point loop; phase times are accumulated locally and committed once per angular block.
counters.measurement_basis_modulus_combinations: Exact number of active measurement/basis/five-modulus combinations observed in the existing fused contraction loop; no separate activity scan.

accounting.sum_rule: Use exclusive times only; inclusive parent and child times overlap and are not additive.
accounting.unassigned: The API root exclusive residual is retained and must not be relabeled as a mathematical stage.
accounting.timer_granularity: Coarse stages use API, response-family, frequency-degree, or angular-block scopes. Inside the original fused node/place loop, raw timestamp intervals are accumulated in local integers and committed once per block; no maps, profiler scopes, or new work buffers are created per point. The disabled-hook clone executes the same source with stamp/elapsed/addChild compiled as no-ops. Instrumented timing includes timestamp-read cost; angular_phase_timer_reads records its call count, and native-versus-instrumented timing controls bound aggregate overhead.
accounting.threading: The instrumented API verifies that the OpenMP team has exactly one thread so the shared thread-local profiler remains valid.

comparability_limit: ComputeSampledKernels returns sampled volumetric kernels. It constructs measurement adjoint spectra and receiver unit-force fields for the kernel, but it does not return the DSpec forward/receiver spectra, time-series postprocessing, or an objective value. Do not describe these as missing YSpec work or perform extra unrequested solves.
